items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Those are all, that's like, oh there's Bruce (Bitwas) the regular drummer who plays the #traps# And the two percussion players, Palmer Lambkin and Sue Evans

ctx.x: She gets $250 a concert, so if she goes out for a few days each week it can give her a thousand, you know, save it up. She does it for a few people a couple of months of the year. Yes, that's what she's doing now. She's just luckily back in town for Monday.

Then I have another percussionist who is a friend of mine and he's a composer really and a vibraphonist but he's just around a lot and all of a sudden I got the idea having him play some percussion too. His name is Palmer Lambkin.
